name: Jennifer Lawrynn
tagline: Build clear, maintainable engineering systems that remove manual work and give people reliable tools for everyday operations.
problem: Engineering teams and small businesses lose time when software delivery, repetitive workflows and operational applications are treated as disconnected manual tasks. My work focuses on turning messy needs into tools with clear interfaces, automation and security boundaries.
scenario: A new product requires a web experience, backend services and repeatable delivery. I first define the trust and data boundaries, then choose an appropriate stack, ship a testable implementation and automate the maintenance steps that are otherwise repeated by hand.
differentiation: I connect full-stack application delivery, DevOps workflow automation and security-first design. The projects below show real public repositories and explicitly separate shipped tools from ongoing research instead of claiming capabilities that are still prototypes.
architecture: Selected repositories cover React/TypeScript frontends, Python or Node-based service boundaries, PostgreSQL-backed business workflows and GitHub Actions delivery. AppFactory coordinates reusable project scaffolding while AgentShield explores separately enforced tool authorization for AI agents.
limitations: This profile is a public portfolio, not a blanket production certification for every linked repository. Some work is in development, some code is proprietary, and third-party performance or security claims require individual project evidence.
